description: Inclusive number of days between two dates, plus business days after optionally excluding weekends and 2026 US federal holidays, calendar weeks, weekend days, and holidays in the range. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive date duration calculator calculator.

exclude_holidays.description: Exclude 2026 US federal holidays from the business day count.

exclude_weekends.description: Exclude Saturdays and Sundays from the business day count. The page has this checked by default.

name: calculate_date_duration
